Method of Attack: cyber-enabled heists against foreign financial institutions to generate revenue for North Korean regime
targeting financial institutions in multiple countries
Discoverer: U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
Impacted Systems: financial institutions in India, Mexico, Pakistan, Philippines, South Korea, Taiwan, Turkey, Chile, Vietnam
Indicators of Compromise: attempted $1 billion heist on Bangladesh Central Bank
successful theft of $81 million from four transfers out of 35
